kinetic.loading.sodium: Kinetic and Sodium are both performance mods that replace the same parts of the game, so they cannot run together. Remove one of them and start the game again. Kinetic only starts next to Sodium for its own benchmark (-Dkinetic.benchmark=true).
kinetic.configuration.title: Kinetic Settings
kinetic.configuration.overlayVisible.too: Adds Kinetic's frame rate, 1% and 0.1% lows, server tick time, garbage collector pauses, memory, culling and distant terrain details to the F3 debug screen.
kinetic.configuration.targetFps.tooltip: The frame rate you aim for. Kinetic measures slow frames against this target.
kinetic.configuration.dynamicFps.tooltip: Lowers the frame rate while the game window is in the background or the game is paused, to save power and keep your PC cool. The world keeps ticking at full speed.
kinetic.configuration.unfocusedFps.toolt: Frame rate limit while another window has the focus.
kinetic.configuration.pausedFps.tooltip: Frame rate limit while the single player game is paused.
kinetic.configuration.occlusionCulling.t: Skips terrain hidden behind solid blocks, like caves behind stone, and shadow casters the sun cannot see. The picture stays the same.
kinetic.configuration.leafCulling.toolti: Skips leaf faces buried two or more leaves deep inside a tree. Forests draw faster, but trees look slightly less dense through the gaps in the leaves, so it is off by default. Only matters with detailed (cutout) leaves; changing it rebuilds the chunks.
kinetic.configuration.distantTerrain.too: Draws the landscape far beyond your render distance as simplified terrain. In single player, places you have not visited yet are computed from the world seed; seen chunks replace them with their real look.
kinetic.configuration.distantTerrainDist: How far simplified terrain reaches, in chunks (64 to 512). Fog moves out with it.
kinetic.configuration.distantTerrainQual: How much detail distant terrain keeps near you. Higher quality draws finer terrain closer to you and computes more of it.
kinetic.configuration.distantTerrainPowe: How many processor threads compute unvisited terrain from the seed. Higher settings fill the distance faster but leave less room for the game.
kinetic.configuration.pregenerate.toolti: While the loading screen is up, generates, loads and prepares every chunk around you up to the radius below. When you enter, the terrain is complete: no holes, no chunks popping in, no generation stutter in the first minutes. The first opening of a new world takes a little longer. Single player worlds only.
kinetic.configuration.pregenerationRadiu: How many chunks around you are ready when you enter (6 to 32). It never goes past your render distance, because chunks beyond it are not shown anyway. Larger values make the first opening of a new world take longer.
kinetic.config.title: Kinetic
kinetic.config.brand.subtitle: Performance engine
kinetic.config.distantTerrain.notice: In single player, unvisited land is computed from the world seed in the background. On servers, only terrain seen in this session is drawn. With Helion installed, Helion lights and fogs it.
kinetic.config.modules.notice: Changes apply after a restart. Renderer modules stay off when Sodium or Iris is installed.
kinetic.config.preset.performance.descri: Distant terrain reaches 128 chunks, pregeneration covers 12 chunks, and leaf culling is on.
kinetic.config.preset.balanced.descripti: Distant terrain reaches 256 chunks, pregeneration covers 16 chunks, and leaf culling is on.
kinetic.config.preset.quality.descriptio: Distant terrain reaches 512 chunks, pregeneration covers 32 chunks, and leaf culling is off.
kinetic.config.meter.note: Stored samples of the distant terrain.
kinetic.config.overlayVisible.descriptio: Shows Kinetic's performance details on the F3 debug screen only.
kinetic.config.targetFps.description: Sets the frame rate target used to judge slow frames and does not limit the game by itself.
kinetic.config.dynamicFps.description: Lowers frame rate in the background or while paused to save power.
kinetic.config.unfocusedFps.description: Sets the frame rate limit while another window is active and makes the game less responsive there.
kinetic.config.pausedFps.description: Sets the frame rate limit while a single player game is paused and saves power.
kinetic.config.distantTerrain.descriptio: Draws terrain beyond the normal render distance, computing unvisited land from the seed, and uses extra memory.
kinetic.config.distantTerrainDistance.de: Sets how far distant terrain reaches; longer distances use more memory and graphics time.
kinetic.config.distantTerrainQuality.des: Sets how much detail distant terrain keeps; higher quality uses more memory and graphics time.
kinetic.config.distantTerrainPower.descr: Sets how much processor power computes unvisited terrain; higher settings fill the distance faster.
kinetic.config.occlusionCulling.descript: Skips terrain hidden behind solid blocks and uses a little background processing.
kinetic.config.leafCulling.description: Skips hidden leaf faces for faster forests, but trees can look less dense.
kinetic.config.pregenerate.description: Prepares the nearby world before you enter, making the loading screen take longer.
kinetic.config.pregenerationRadius.descr: Sets how much terrain is ready on entry; larger radii make the first load longer.
kinetic.config.module.shaderCache.descri: Saves compiled shaders for faster later starts and uses disk space.
kinetic.config.module.pipelineCache.desc: Saves graphics pipelines for faster later starts and uses disk space.
kinetic.config.module.pipelineWarmup.des: Prepares common graphics pipelines while loading and uses a little background work.
Uses less memory for loaded chunks while keeping their safety checks.
Remembers terrain locations for faster drawing and uses some memory.
kinetic.config.module.lightSnapshots.des: Copies only changed light data to reduce memory pressure and uses bookkeeping work.
kinetic.config.module.occlusionCulling.d: Skips hidden terrain, entities and particles while using background processing.
kinetic.config.module.meshWorkers.descri: Builds terrain on dedicated workers and uses processor time in the background.
kinetic.config.module.faceCulling.descri: Sends only terrain faces that can face you to the graphics card.
kinetic.config.module.poiSearch.descript: Makes villagers search fewer empty places and uses a little memory for lists.
kinetic.config.module.entityCollisions.d: Skips empty entity collision searches and uses memory to track nearby entities.
kinetic.config.module.hopperSearch.descr: Skips empty hopper item searches and uses memory to track nearby items.
kinetic.config.module.compactVertices.de: Stores terrain in less graphics memory and may need a short rebuild after loading.
kinetic.config.module.networkCompression: Compresses server packets faster at the cost of slightly more network data.
kinetic.config.module.parallelFeatures.d: Generates trees and ores on several server threads and uses more processor time.
kinetic.config.module.blockEntitySection: Organizes block entities by section for faster drawing and uses some memory.
kinetic.config.module.directDraws.descri: Writes terrain draw commands directly to graphics memory and uses more graphics memory.
kinetic.config.module.dirtySections.desc: Tracks only terrain that needs rebuilding and uses a small amount of memory.
kinetic.config.module.gpuCulling.descrip: Lets supported graphics cards choose terrain to draw and uses a little graphics time.
kinetic.config.module.sectionGridMoves.d: Updates only moved terrain columns when you cross chunk borders and uses bookkeeping memory.
kinetic.config.module.lockFreeSections.d: Keeps terrain drawing from waiting on builders and uses extra coordination memory.
kinetic.config.module.swapchainImages.de: Keeps extra finished frames ready to reduce stalls and uses more graphics memory.
kinetic.config.module.chunkPacketDecodin: Unpacks incoming chunks in the background and uses processor time there.
kinetic.config.module.spawnPregeneration: Prepares the world before entry so joining takes longer but terrain is ready.
kinetic.config.module.joinWarmup.descrip: Loads common game code before your first world and uses background processor time.
kinetic.config.module.preciseFrameTime.d: Makes high frame rate movement smoother and uses more precise timing work.
kinetic.config.module.particleCollisions: Particles flying through open air skip the block collision search; they move exactly as before.
kinetic.config.module.modelCorners.descr: Reuses transformed model corners for faster rendering and uses a little temporary memory.
kinetic.config.module.teamlessPushing.de: Skips team checks in worlds without teams and has no visible cost.
kinetic.config.module.distantTerrain.des: Draws seen terrain beyond the normal render distance and uses extra memory.
kinetic.hardware.title: Kinetic set up this PC
kinetic.hardware.low: Lighter settings for this hardware: shorter view and simulation distance, leaf culling on.
kinetic.hardware.medium: Lighter settings for this hardware: view and simulation distance capped.
